title: Field-specific university deserts and their origins in Peru: code and data
description: Python pipeline, public source data and derived datasets that reproduce every table and figure of the article Field-Specific University Deserts and Their Origins: Remoteness, Topography and Licensing in Peru. It measures university deserts by field of study for 537,451 final-year secondary students with straight-line distance and road and river travel time calibrated against Google Maps, separates structural, topographic and licensing-related deserts using SUNEDU's 2018 identity-card register, and estimates their territorial correlates with fractional logit models.
